body.prompt:
Stylized 3D miniature diorama of an "AI 3D asset production workshop" on a rectangular warm-wood tabletop, 3/4 isometric camera, dark charcoal studio background. Soft warm key light from upper left, gentle rim light, soft contact shadows, slight tilt-shift depth of field. Clean game-art style, smooth bevelled shapes, matte painted materials with small metal details.

A short dark-grey conveyor belt carrying tiny glowing orange cubes runs left to right, connecting four clearly separated machines in order:
1. A teal (#3fa7a0) boxy 3D-printer-like generator machine with a glass chamber where a small orange 3D model is forming from light.
2. A low orange (#e07a3f) craftsman workbench with a vise, small tools and a small grey 3D model being cleaned up.
3. A round white display pedestal holding a small orange model, surrounded by four tiny cameras on tripods pointing at it from different angles, with a purple (#b05cc8) light ring.
4. A tall grey metal storage shelf with small boxes and neatly arranged finished miniature models.

Readable silhouettes, generous spacing between machines, cohesive palette of teal, orange, purple and grey on warm wood. --no text, logos, people, clutter
